# `Http.StatusCode`

[Back to stdlib index](../stdlib.md)

Ipe.Http.StatusCode — a typed HTTP response status code (Layer 3 Ipe source).

A `StatusCode` wraps the raw integer code returned by `HttpResponse.status`.
Any received integer is a valid status code (the set is open: servers may
return non-standard codes), so there is no rejection boundary — `fromInt` is
always `Ok` by construction.  The typed wrapper prevents treating a status
code as an arbitrary integer (arithmetic, string formatting) while still
giving safe classification access.

Build from a raw `Int` with `fromInt`; recover the raw value with `code`.
Use the four classifiers (`isSuccess`, `isRedirect`, `isClientError`,
`isServerError`) to branch on the status class without touching the raw number.

Typical use inside an `Ipe.Http` callback:

    describe : StatusCode -> String
    describe sc =
        if StatusCode.isSuccess sc then
            "2xx: handled"

        else if StatusCode.isClientError sc then
            "4xx: the request was refused"

        else
            "another status"

called as `describe (Http.statusCode resp)`.

## `StatusCode`

An opaque HTTP status code.  Any received integer is valid; the constructor
is NOT exported so a bare `Int` cannot accidentally be used as a `StatusCode`.

## `fromInt`

```ipe
fromInt : Int -> StatusCode
```

`fromInt n` — wrap any `Int` as a `StatusCode`.  Total: every integer is a
valid status code (no rejection, no `Result`).

## `code`

```ipe
code : StatusCode -> Int
```

`code sc` — recover the raw integer for logging, comparison, or forwarding.

## `isSuccess`

```ipe
isSuccess : StatusCode -> Bool
```

`isSuccess sc` — true when the code is in the 2xx range (200–299).

## `isRedirect`

```ipe
isRedirect : StatusCode -> Bool
```

`isRedirect sc` — true when the code is in the 3xx range (300–399).

## `isClientError`

```ipe
isClientError : StatusCode -> Bool
```

`isClientError sc` — true when the code is in the 4xx range (400–499).

## `isServerError`

```ipe
isServerError : StatusCode -> Bool
```

`isServerError sc` — true when the code is in the 5xx range (500–599).
